COMPLETED WATERPROOFING PACKAGE
SealRight supplied membrane rolls and completed roof-deck waterproofing for PHP 210,000. Delivery to site and cranage included. 30% mobilization, 70% after flood testing. Material warranty ten years; workmanship warranty three years. SealRight is an accredited applicator.

Both the membrane and waterproofing work are subject to the manufacturer's dry-weather application requirement. 'Subject to standard conditions' appeared alone with no identifiable target and must not be guessed. Invoice settled; ask accounts to archive the receipt.

human_approval.rationale: Grouped, split, replicated, provider-specific, and ambiguous-target annotation draft awaiting human review.
